body: Fable2 #3599 (2026-11-01): run a PROCESS CENSUS on Central (cargo, rustc and test-binary processes plus their roots/command lines) IMMEDIATELY before every full-gate launch, and record it. Checking master, HEAD and the worktree is not enough. Cause: the w-135181 R12 gate test-fe3503b6 overlapped Opus3's w-2d99 focused run test-d6288bbc (started 11 s earlier) for 9.4 minutes. Overlaps are recorded on the item; a timing failure inside an overlap is investigated with the overlap as a candidate cause, with no automatic rerun. Census command idea (PowerShell): Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^(cargo|rustc|termal|node)' } | Select ProcessId, Name, CommandLine.
